source.document_id: HW-FR-009 retention hold-up capacitor specification, HwRS.md v0.2.0 (section 3)

note: H-01 fixes the requirement bounds and one engineering budget; the vendor datasheet (with table and page) replaces the budget entries at H-02 BOM selection. No value in this extract is an un-cited number (HwAGENTS.md rule 2). H-04 provenance: no source PDF is retained; source_url is a fallback, not a verified PDF digest. H-09 (issue #56): R_path is closed by the T0 WCCA (docs/hw/wcca-derating.md WCCA-R-001, citation_type wcca_analysis); ESR_budget remains a budget until the H-02 vendor datasheet.

entries.name: C_nominal
entries.condition: Nominal hold-up capacitance; requirement is C >= 10 uF
entries.citation: HwRS.md HW-FR-009 (v0.2.0): 'hold-up capacitor of value C >= 10 uF ... standard value 10 uF'

entries.name: I_leak_max
entries.condition: Maximum capacitor leakage at 85 degC (requirement bound)

entries.name: ESR_budget
entries.condition: Engineering budget (typical low-ESR 10 uF ceramic/polymer class). Sensitivity: in the covered constant-current discharge the ESR drop is I*ESR <= 3.4e-7 V, i.e. ~3 orders of magnitude below the declared 1e-3 V tolerance, so the budget cannot flip the acceptance verdict; pinned by the H-02 vendor datasheet.
entries.citation: HwAGENTS.md rule 2 (no value without an extract); vendor datasheet table due at H-02 BOM selection

entries.name: R_path
entries.condition: Ohmic series resistance of the VBAT charge path (trace + vias; the ideal-diode forward drop is bounded separately by WCCA-A-004 and the ESR by ESR_budget). WCCA upper bound: R_path_worst_case = 0.044229 ohm at 85 degC under the layout allowances WCCA-A-005/A-006, so 0.05 ohm holds with 11.5 % margin. Not exercised by holdup_001 (the diode is off for the whole event); shapes charge dynamics in the planned holdup_charge_001 case. Re-pinned by the netlist/layout query (OR-005).
entries.citation: docs/hw/wcca-derating.md WCCA-R-001 (H-09, issue #56); inputs hw/bom/datasheets/extract-wcca-allowances.json (R_path_worst_case, R_path_bound) and extract-copper-ipc2221.json (IEC 60028 copper constants)
